name: Architecture Guardian
description: Validates code against rulesproyect.md standards. Runs multiple skills in sequence and reports violations.

skills.name: Validate SQL Parameters
skills.description: Ensures all SQL uses parameterized queries ($1, $2...), no concatenation

skills.name: Validate Component Size
skills.description: Ensures functional components don't exceed 800 lines

skills.name: Validate Naming Conventions
skills.description: Validates PascalCase (components), camelCase (hooks), kebab-case (folders), snake_case (DB), SCREAMING_SNAKE (env)

usage.manual: Invoke from Claude Code with /agent architecture-guardian
usage.automatic: Configure git hooks to run before commit/push (future)
